name: test-data-generator-t1-cli-ts
instr:
Can't generate reproducible fixtures for our test setup

Our test setup uses `@lambdatest/test-data-generator` to prepare localized user records and transaction fixtures. We need repeatable data for replaying failures, exports for loading fixtures, and the related generators for validation cases and linked records. These features currently stop at throwing stubs.

This is the kind of call our fixture script makes:

```ts
import { runCli } from '@lambdatest/test-data-generator';
const fixture = runCli([
  'users', '--count', '12', '--seed', 'fixture-replay',
  '--locale', 'de', '--format', 'csv',
]);
console.log(fixture.output);
```

The documented behavior would give us reproducible localized fixtures in the requested format. Instead, `runCli` throws `Error("not implemented")`, and the library features needed by our other fixture scripts are also incomplete.

The throwing stubs are in `src/cli.ts`, `src/generator.ts`, `src/dataset.ts`, `src/schema.ts`, `src/export.ts`, and these files under `src/modules/`: `boundary.ts`, `date.ts`, `finance.ts`, `helpers.ts`, `id.ts`, `location.ts`, `lorem.ts`, `person.ts`, `phone.ts`, and `string.ts`. The missing regex support lives in `src/internal/regex-gen.ts`.

Could you implement these features according to their doc comments? The `README.md` also describes them in “CLI”, “Exporting”, “Schema-based records”, “Relational datasets”, “Boundary-value testing”, “Templates”, “Uniqueness guarantees”, “Regex-constrained strings”, “Localization”
